title: dCanvas 2.0
description: Dialog Canvas format v2.0 — a strict superset of JSON Canvas 1.0 with x- extension fields for game dialog metadata.

x-dCanvasVersion.description: Format version identifier. Must be "2.0" for this schema.

nodes.description: Canvas nodes in ascending z-index order.

canvasColor.description: Node or edge color. Either a hex color (e.g. "#FF0000") or a preset number ("1"–"6").

side.description: Side of a node where an edge connects.

character.description: Speaker information for a dialog node.

name.description: Character display name (e.g. "Abela the Nymph", "End dialog").

portrait.description: Portrait image filename relative to portraits directory. Empty string or "None.png" means no portrait.

node.description: A canvas node. Only text-type nodes carry dialog extension fields.

text.description: Clean dialog text only — no YAML front-matter, no journal separator.

subpath.description: Subpath linking to a heading or block within a file (file-type nodes).

x-nodeRole.description: Role in the dialog tree. "state" for NPC lines/dialog states, "transition" for player choices/flow control.

x-textId.description: Dialog string reference in the game's string table (e.g. "#2687").

x-sound.description: Sound resource name from the game's string table, associated with this dialog line.

x-journalTextId.description: Journal string reference in the game's string table.

x-journalText.description: Journal text content, stored separately from the dialog text in the text field.

x-journalSound.description: Sound resource name from the game's string table, associated with the journal entry.

x-trigger.description: Game-engine trigger/condition script evaluated when entering this node.

x-action.description: Game-engine action script executed when this node is reached.

fromSide.description: Side of the source node where the edge starts.

fromEnd.description: Endpoint shape at edge start. Defaults to "none".

toSide.description: Side of the destination node where the edge ends.

toEnd.description: Endpoint shape at edge end. Defaults to "arrow".

label.description: Free text label for display purposes. Not used for game-engine conditions (use x-condition instead).

x-condition.description: Game-engine condition expression that gates this transition.
